decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's direction toward binding mobile communication, and with growing demand for secure digital interaction after 2020 there is no shortfall against aspirations to trigger search.
Mobile PDF signing supports the strategic push toward online contract signing, and remote contracting grew after 2020, so carrying it costs little relative to its fit.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture frames the integrated portfolio itself, so dropping it would free few resources and would weaken the overall positioning.

The email-to-app robot remains a niche add-on with uncertain results and is the likeliest candidate for consolidation, but slack and its fit with secure app-based messaging still justify carrying it for now.
